review_comments.body: How about we phrase this a little more like the chatlas example? I don't know what a 400 error is off the top of my head, but "deprecated" make sense instantly to me.

comments.body: Good call, reworded in 057384f to match the chatlas docs: `budget_tokens` is now described as deprecated on Opus/Sonnet 4.6 and not supported by later models (including the default, Claude Sonnet 5), with no mention of the 400 error. The `.Rd` matches.
Hi @thisisnic, the wording now follows chatlas ("deprecated", without the note about the 400) in 057384f, including the regenerated `.Rd`. Could you take another look when you have a moment? Thanks!
Tweaked it a little more but will merge now. Thanks!
